title: Fairness Testing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: How Small Perturbations Reveal Bias in Small Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Metamorphic testing using a Set Equivalence Metamorphic Relation Test (MRT), which introduces racial demographic perturbations into text prompts and measures changes in the retriever's semantic stability (Retriever Robustness Score) and the final sentiment classification (Attack Success Rate).
